tools/gimp.scope: Raster image editing; not identical Photoshop features or workflows.

tools/libreoffice.scope: Documents, spreadsheets and presentations; file and macro compatibility have limits.

tools/joplin.scope: Notes with documented import routes; migration and feature coverage differ.

tools/darktable.scope: RAW photo workflow; the project explicitly warns it is not a direct replacement.

tools/penpot.scope: Interface design and prototyping; not full feature equivalence.

tools/kdenlive.scope: Non-linear video editing; not identical professional workflows or project-file compatibility.

tools/nextcloud.scope: File storage, sync and sharing; self-hosting and administration differ from hosted services.
